title: Period-67 and period-127 finite kill deposits and denominator exclusion

concepts.label: fixed period kill certificates
concepts.note: Exact kernel-checked certifiedKill instances at periods 67 and 127 and basepoint 300.

concepts.label: single locked full-depth instance
concepts.note: One period-67 certificate whose depth equals its period; this is one matrix instance, not the global full-depth producer.

concepts.label: fixed period-127 denominator class
concepts.note: Rational denominators dividing 2^300 times 2^127-1, excluded by the fixed certificate.

concepts.label: finite versus cofinal boundary
concepts.note: Finite certificates and denominator exclusions do not establish either open cofinal supply authored in Z45.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Lean proves certifiedKill 67 300 11 and certifiedKill 127 300 11. These are two exact kernel-checked central-residue certificates at the common basepoint 300 and depth 11.
statement_nodes.engine: Kernel evaluation of the certifiedKill predicate at the two displayed parameter triples.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Kernel-checked finite instances of the existing certified-kill predicate; no novelty or asymptotic claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: These two fixed cells establish no cofinal supply, do not propagate to multiples, adjacent periods, or other basepoints, and do not by themselves prove irrationality.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: Lean proves certifiedKill 67 300 67. Thus the matrix of the open depth-locked producer is inhabited at the single local choice d=67, N=300, and t=1.
statement_nodes.engine: Kernel evaluation of certifiedKill at the fixed period, basepoint, and locked depth.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: One kernel-checked local instance of the matrix quantified by ApFullDepthEscape; no novelty or global producer claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: One local full-depth instance does not prove ApFullDepthEscape, gives no witness for other d or N, and does not assert that depth 67 is minimal or arithmetically distinguished.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For every rational r, if r.den divides 2^300 * (2^127 - 1), then the binary totient series is not equal to r.
statement_nodes.engine: The generic denominator-exclusion theorem applied to the fixed certifiedKill 127 300 11 instance.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Direct application of the generic denominator-exclusion theorem to the fixed period-127 certificate.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The result covers only denominators dividing the displayed fixed integer. It excludes no rational outside that divisor class, does not require or prove primality of 2^127-1, and does not establish irrationality.

intra_zone_relations.basis: Both nodes record the period-67/basepoint-300 cell at different depths: the depth-67 theorem exposes one locked-depth instance, while the depth-11 theorem records the shorter firing certificate.
The denominator exclusion applies the residual generic theorem totient_series_ne_rat_of_certifiedKill to certifiedKill_127_300.
